Name: Money Sinks - The Forbidden Grind
Author: Nullnnow
Description:
[size=4][b]!!! WARNING: Do not install this mod unless you hate yourself !!![/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]This mod adds 2 new towers that you can build from the wizard's tower, a golden and an iridium tower. In order to build the iridium tower, you must first build and fill the golden tower. Towers can be filled using coins purchased from Pierre's. Interacting with the towers will give you a small amount of gold each day once they are full.[/size][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]If I both see people fill the iridium tower and if there is a demand for it, I'll add a 3rd, radioactive tower. [/size][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Below is a list of approximately how much gold it takes to fill each tower given the selected price setting.[/size][/color]
[spoiler][color=#D4D4D8][size=3][b]Cheap[/b]
Golden Tower: 100 Million
Iridium Tower: 10 Billion
Radioactive Tower: 2.5 Trillion

[b]Expensive[/b]
Golden Tower: 1 Billion
Iridium Tower: 1 Trillion
Radioactive Tower:  2.5 Quadrillion

[b]Very Expensive[/b]
Golden Tower: 10 Billion
Iridium Tower: 100 Trillion
Radioactive Tower: 250 Quadrillion[/size][/color][/spoiler]

Manifest.Name: Money Sinks - The Forbidden Grind
Manifest.Description: Adds towers that you can spend large sums of money on.
